chapters.title: Shapes Around Us
covers: Builds a model of a city monument from wooden blocks and names the parts used
Makes prisms and pyramids from paper and card
Opens a box into its net and folds it back
Fills a table counting faces, corners and edges for a cube, cuboid, prism and pyramid
Notices patterns in the counts, for example that a cube is also a prism

chapters.title: Hide and Seek
topics: views of objects: top, front and side
covers: Matches three drawings of the same brick to the child who drew each one, and explains why they differ
Works out which view a picture shows: top, front or side
Decides what a person standing at one spot can see of the children who are hiding
Looks at a tree from the top and from the front and compares the two

chapters.title: Pattern Around Us
covers: Counts coconut trees and the coconuts on them by multiplying equal groups
Counts laddoos and pedas in stacked trays with the same arrangement
Works out the value of play money laid out in patterns
Makes amounts such as 36, 125 and 183 rupees with notes and coins and asks classmates to find them
Compares two ways of arranging coins and writes the number of each

chapters.title: Thousands Around Us
covers: Writes donation quantities such as 4 ones and 7 tens, or ten more than 312, as numbers
Shows numbers such as 52 and 145 people with hundred, ten and one blocks
Estimates large numbers from real life, such as the people at a community lunch
Places numbers in order and finds the largest of a set
Lists things in the classroom, school or village that come in counts of 1, 10, 100 or 1000

chapters.title: Sharing and Measuring
covers: Decides whether one half or two quarters of a sheet is the bigger share
Folds paper to check whether a shape has been divided into equal parts
Colours figures that are correctly divided into halves
Draws a line to split shapes into halves
Shares a whole into equal parts and names each part

chapters.title: Measuring Length
topics: metre, half metre and quarter metre
covers: Measures a classroom object and checks if it is longer or shorter than a metre
Makes ropes of 1 metre, half a metre and quarter metre, and finds how they fit together
Uses a measuring tape or ruler to measure in centimetres
Finds that tall, wide, deep and long all measure length, depending on how an object is held
Estimates the length of an object before measuring it

chapters.title: The Cleanest Village
covers: Reads a poster for a school field trip to a village and works out the cost per child
Works out the cost of fruit and vegetables bought per kilogram
Finds the balance when a sum of money is paid for a bill, such as 150 rupees paid for 113 rupees of shopping
Works out how much money is needed for groceries and snacks for a trip
Checks a shopkeeper's balance using a number line or play money

chapters.title: Weigh it, Pour it
covers: Orders animals by weight from heaviest to lightest
Estimates the weight of objects, then checks with a weighing balance
Works out how many 250 gram packets make 1 kilogram
Shares a total weight into equal packets, for example 10 packets of 100 grams
Pours liquid and compares capacities of different containers

chapters.title: Equal Groups
covers: Finds which numbers an animal lands on when it jumps 3, 4, 6 or 8 steps at a time
Works out which numbers are common to two animals' jumps
Writes multiplication statements, such as 12 times 3 for 12 groups of 3
Works out the petals in 10 lilies by multiplying groups
Groups 80 petals in fives to find how many flowers there are, since 5 petals make 1 flower

chapters.title: Elephants, Tigers, and Leopards
topics: addition of large numbers with carrying
covers: Plays a two-player game of adding 1 or 2 to reach a target number and works out who wins
Reads an addition chart and notices patterns in the sums
Finds the total of two elephant counts in neighbouring states, estimating first
Reverses a 2-digit number, adds the two, and checks what happens for other numbers
Adds numbers in ones, tens, hundreds and thousands using place value

chapters.title: Fun with Symmetry
covers: Makes an ink design by folding paper and finds the line of symmetry
Folds and flies paper aeroplanes and marks the lines of symmetry on them
Works out where a mirror would show the reflection of one half
Tests whether a plane made without symmetry flies as well as a symmetrical one
Shares observations with friends about symmetry

chapters.title: Ticking Clocks and Turning Calendar
topics: hours and minutes in a day
covers: Works out the number of days in February in 2024 and 2025 and what a leap year is
Lists the leap years before and after 2024
Finds the day of the week for yesterday, tomorrow and other days from a given day
Counts how long a biscuit packet has been made and how many days are left before it expires
Reads clock times for a doctor's day, from waking up to reaching the hospital

chapters.title: The Transport Museum
covers: Multiplies a number by 10 using tens and hundreds blocks
Builds a times table for 15 and notices the pattern in the answers
Splits a 5 times 15 arrangement into 5 times 10 and 5 times 5 to find the product
Fills in a number grid where the row and column products are given
Counts pebbles in an arrangement and writes it as a multiplication

chapters.title: Data Handling
covers: Chooses which question will best find the most liked subject in a class
Records children's answers with letter codes and tallies them
Fills a table with counts for each subject and finds the most liked
Asks classmates which gola colour they like best and compares counts
Shows the results as a pictograph
